notes.title: Update notes for September 2025
notes.content: [h2]What's new in this update:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Achievements:[/b] 20 new achievements. Some of them can only be acquired in levels with certain buffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Click heat:[/b] Players were clicking too fast and were missing much of the game experience. notes.title: Update notes for August 2025
notes.content:
New month, new update!
[list]
[*] Enemies now have healthbars which gives more room for tactics
[*] Added enemy variability
[*] Added Stats
[*] Better healing animations
[*] More gameplay music tracks
[*] Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Mission freezing after playing a level with inspect buttons
[*] Mortar bug freezing game on restart
[/list]
[/list]
